explication: Smart Cities Data Platform is a suite of Elixir services for dataset administration, ingestion and transformation, persistence, discovery, and streaming access. The documented workflow begins with dataset and ingestion configuration in Andi, then validates, retrieves, and transforms source data before persisting it for querying and exposing it through discovery APIs and WebSockets. Kafka carries service messages and the shared event bus; object storage and Presto support durable data access. The graph combines README-level system relationships with the excerpted Andi ingestion and Kafka topic code; many service internals were not sampled, so their detailed calls are not inferred.
